card.name: Spot just before a quantity or duration
card.fires_on: Punctuation, units or numbers right before an amount, time span or dose value is about to be given, as in table cells or after a question like 'How long?'. The next word is usually a number or 'a couple'.

modes.label: Answer to a duration question
modes.description: The quote or comma just before a vague time span like 'a couple of weeks'.
modes.example: How long?<< ">>Oh, a couple of weeks

modes.label: Dose table cells
modes.description: A unit, bracket or number at the end of a table cell, right before the dose or time entry.
modes.example: Strength Usual Adult Dosage Maximum Daily Dose Oxycodone and acetaminophen tablets 2.5 mg/325<< mg>> 1 or 2 tablets every

modes.label: Label before a duration
modes.description: A colon after a label such as Duration, right before the time value.
modes.example: - Tools used: Photoshop CS - Duration<<:>> 30 minutes (approx.) -

card.writes: It pushes words for vague counts and spans, such as 'several', 'dozens' and Chinese words for 'a few days'.
card.plain: It fires at the point where a number or length of time is about to be stated.
